text_block_list.text: That wasn't the first time.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
That 2,400-meter turf race the three of
us ran
right after we entered the
academy—the race that
brought us
together...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: That wasn't the first time we raced.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
You probably don't remember, but I
once raced
against you...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Hayahide.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Wheeze...
text_block_list.name: Young Taishin

text_block_list.text:
The winner of the Kiddy Race is Biwa
Hayahide!
Coming in second is Narita
Brian! Congrats to
these two amazing
sisters!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!
Dang it! You really are fast, Big Sis!
text_block_list.name: Young Brian

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I can't be losing to my little sister
just yet!
text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide

text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go home and talk about
our race!
We have to get better if we
wanna race in the
Twinkle Series
together!
text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide

text_block_list.text:
Those two sisters were incredible! I don't
think
I've seen Umamusume run that fast
before,
especially not at the Kiddy Race!
text_block_list.name: Passerby A

text_block_list.text:
If they keep it up and continue their
training, I
bet we'll see great things from
them in the future.
text_block_list.name: Passerby B

text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see them race in the
Twinkle Series
one day!
text_block_list.name: Passerby B

text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, Taishin? Did you get
hurt?
text_block_list.name: Taishin's Mother

text_block_list.text: No. I'm fine.
text_block_list.name: Young Taishin

text_block_list.text: That's good... Listen, Taishin.
text_block_list.name: Taishin's Mother

text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.name: Young Taishin

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry you're so small... It's all my
fault...
text_block_list.name: Taishin's Mother

text_block_list.text: (Argh. Dammit!)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho's coming up. I need to
get some
solo training in...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Cough, cough! Hack!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: (Ugh, what's all that racket...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yeesh! How's she still speeding up?! Her
time for
the last three furlongs is off the
charts!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Hayahide's been in another league ever
since the
end of summer camp. I wonder
what's gonna
happen at the Kikuka
Sho...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: Hayahide...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Nnngh!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Oh, Taishin! Taaaiiishiiin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: ...I hear you, Ticket.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey! Did you see Hayahide's
run?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: She was unreeeaaal!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna lose to her after seeing
that!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Taishin? What's up?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: You're looking kinda under the wea—
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Whoa! Wait, Taishin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(Run! Run, run, run! I've gotta keep
running! I'm
nowhere near ready!)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(After watching Hayahide, I couldn't
even
imagine myself winning. But Ticket
wasn't fazed at
all!)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: (At this rate, I'm gonna get left behind!)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Wheeze!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Cough... wheeze... Splutter!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hey, are you okay?! You're all
pale!
text_block_list.name: Passerby C

text_block_list.text: S-somebody call an ambulance!
text_block_list.name: Passerby C

text_block_list.text:
(I'm gonna be the only one... left
behind...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(No one will accept me... I'll be back to
getting
teased like before...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Huh, where am I?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I was running just now... How'd I end up
here?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: It doesn't matter. Just rest for now.

text_block_list.text: You're kidding me, right?! The Kikuka Sho's around the corner, and you want me to rest?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Ugh...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин must be in really bad
shape
because instead of fighting back
like usual, she
simply drops her
shoulders in defeat.

Coming in. Ah, good to see that you're
awake
now.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text: Um, hello.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
The doctor asks Нарита Таисин and me a
few
questions while conducting a
thorough
examination on her.

To be completely honest, I can't give
you the
all-clear to race in the Kikuka
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text: What?! Wh-why?! I'm not even injured!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
That's true. You don't have any external
injuries,
but our tests show indications of
minor
inflammation in your respiratory
system.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text:
I assume you've been feeling very
fatigued lately?
I think it will be difficult
for you to fully recover in
time for the
race.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text:
I would go as far to say that you won't
be able to
run well if you participate.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text: No...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
That's my professional opinion as a
doctor, but I'll
leave it up to you to
make the final decision after
you talk
with your trainer.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text: Now then, if you'll excuse me.
text_block_list.name: Doctor

text_block_list.text: ...I'm doing it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I'm gonna race in the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Please!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Please... Please don't tell me not to race.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Racing is all I have. Racing and winning
are
everything to me!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Please, Trainer! If I can't run, then...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I'll be nothing!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин begs me with tears
streaming down
her face.
And I don't have the heart to refuse her.
